decision_conditions:
Condition : 1 - The London Borough of Hounslow as the Local Planning Authority hereby certify that on 04/01/06 the erection of a rear roof extension measuring 38.5 cubic metres was unlawful within the meaning of Section 191 and 192 of the Town and Country Planning Act 1990 for the following reason:
The development falls outside the provisions of Schedule 2, Part 1, Class C of the Town and Country Planning (General Permitted Development) Order 1995 because although the roof extension is less than 40 cubic metres in volume, does not front a highway and the front elevation would only have a rooflight added to it, the cumulative volume of all the extensions, including the roof extension, to the original house would exceed 50 cubic metres.
description: Certificate of lawfulness for the erection of rear roof extension incorporating one roof light to front elevation, and erection of a single storey detached storage shed in rear end of garden to house.
